description: Korean ordinary wage (통상임금) hourly rate and statutory overtime / night / holiday premiums, before and after the Supreme Court en banc ruling of 2024-12-19 (2020다247190) that counts regular bonuses with an employment-on-payday condition. Monthly ordinary wage = base + fixed allowances + annual regular bonus ÷ 12, divided by contracted monthly hours (209 for 40 h/week). Overtime ×1.5, night +0.5, holiday ×1.5 up to 8 h and ×2 beyond; firms under 5 employees pay no premium.

bonusConditional.description: Bonus paid only to those employed on the payday (or after a minimum number of days)

fixedAllowances.description: Monthly allowances paid to everyone at a fixed amount (KRW)

holidayOver8.description: Holiday hours beyond 8 a day (part of holiday)

name: calculate_kr_ordinary_wage
title: Calculate Korea ordinary wage
